input.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted the covenant barring the Company from participating in any similar Internet project for Deerskin Products or "substantially similar" products, as we cannot accept restrictions on the channels we operate or the products we source or build; HDI's exclusive right to the "Deerskin" branded site is preserved. If HDI needs protection, we can accept a fallback limited to Deerskin Products only, during the term, with carve-outs for our internal development and acquired businesses.
input.summary: Delete the non-compete/field-of-use restriction on the Company in Section 6.1, retaining HDI's brand exclusivity for the Site.
